data.title: Viva Wine Group to Delist as Riesling Ventures Nears Full Control
data.description:
An update from Viva Wine Group AB ( (SE:VIVA) ) is now available.

Viva Wine Group AB’s board has resolved to apply for the delisting of its shares from Nasdaq Stockholm following the near-complete takeover by Riesling Ventures AB. The move comes after the offeror secured acceptances that will give it ownership of 96.4 percent of Viva Wine Group’s shares once consideration is settled on 4 September 2026.

Riesling Ventures has also initiated compulsory redemption proceedings for the remaining shares under the Swedish Companies Act, paving the way for full ownership and a likely transition to private status. In parallel, the offeror has requested an extraordinary general meeting to elect new board members, signalling an imminent shift in governance and strategic control that will materially affect minority shareholders and the company’s capital market presence.

data.title: Nordicus Partners Adds Veteran Independent Director to Board
data.description:
Nordicus Partners ( (NORD) ) has shared an announcement.

On September 1, 2026, Nordicus Partners Corporation appointed finance veteran Elizabeth Addonizio as an independent director to fill a board vacancy, reinforcing its governance and financial oversight as it advances its clinical pipeline. Addonizio brings 25 years of experience in venture and private equity investing, investment banking, and fractional CFO roles, alongside two decades of leadership service in the U.S. Navy Reserve.

Her appointment, accompanied by standard director compensation including cash retainers and fully vested stock options under Nordicus’s 2024 Stock Incentive Plan, is intended to bolster board independence and capital markets expertise. As Nordicus moves oral disorder candidates QR-01 and QR-02 toward clinical trials and continues working toward an exchange uplisting, the board and management highlight her institutional financing and governance background as a key asset for supporting growth and access to institutional capital.

data.title: CSG Injects EUR 49.7 Million Into Tatra Defence Expansion in Kopřivnice
